header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH,
DATE ORDER WITH SIGNATURE OF JUDGE
Mr. Neel Parkash Deputy Prosecutor General Sindh.
This is the second call. None is present on behalf of the appellant.
Record reflects that on 02.12.2025 learned counsel for the appellant sought
time for preparation and matter was adjourned. On the last date of hearing i.e.
15.10.2026 a brief was held on behalf of learned counsel for the appellant.
body: It is observed that today learned counsel for the appellant Mr. Afzal Karim Virk appeared in some other cases and argued the matters; however, he chose to remain absent in the instant matter, which reflects that learned counsel for the appellant is not interested in pursuing the matter. Accordingly, this Court is left with no option but to dismiss the instant Criminal Acquittal Appeal for non-prosecution which stands dismissed for non-prosecution. JUDGE *Chander Kumar*
